name: Cebaracetam
summary: Cebaracetam is an experimental drug of the racetam group described as a nootropic which was never marketed.

pharmacology.text: The mechanism of action of cebaracetam is undefined or unknown.

uses.text: Cebaracetam (INN; developmental code names CGS-25248; ZY-15119) is an experimental drug of the racetam group described as a nootropic which was never marketed. The drug was under development by Novartis for the treatment of cognition disorders by the 1990s but development was discontinued in 1995. It reached phase 2 clinical trials prior to its discontinuation.

fact.en: The racetam family began with piracetam, made in 1964 at the Belgian company UCB. Its developer, the chemist Corneliu Giurgea, coined the word "nootropic" in 1972.
fact.zh: 吡咯烷酮類（racetam）家族始於 1964 年比利時優時比（UCB）公司合成的吡拉西坦。研發者化學家科內留·久爾傑亞在 1972 年創造了「益智藥（nootropic）」這個詞。
fact.zhHans: 吡咯烷酮类（racetam）家族始于 1964 年比利时优时比（UCB）公司合成的吡拉西坦。研发者化学家科内留·久尔杰亚在 1972 年创造了「益智药（nootropic）」这个词。
